# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.53

User-experience pass on the interface.

- **Start screen**: besides "Add scans" there are now "Add folder…" and "Open project…", and a row of profiles to start from (hover for what each does). The chosen profile is shown in the settings.
- **After an export**: "Open" and "Show folder" buttons in the status bar, next to the result message.
- **Shortcuts**: Ctrl+O add scans, Ctrl+Shift+O open project, Ctrl+S save project, Ctrl+E export PDF (shown in the File menu; Ctrl+K command palette as before).
- Includes everything from pre.52 (rescue pass for lines OCR missed, active profile shown, White paper checkbox).
